sections.name: File setup, ScanGroup
sections.title: Imports and shared-source rules
sections.what: Brings in the project and evidence types, the label normalizer, and the budget converter. It also defines the group names used to categorize fields.
sections.why: Likely reason: the header states that this file is the single source for field definitions.
sections.watch_out: Renaming a group changes any code that sorts fields by group, so that code must be updated too.

sections.name: ScanFieldDescriptor
sections.title: Shape of one field definition
sections.what: Defines what each field entry must hold: a key, a group, a way to read its value, and the evidence labels that can back it.
sections.why: Likely reason: a fixed shape keeps every field entry consistent.
sections.watch_out: Evidence labels must match the exact labels stored with evidence rows, or the field silently has no sources.

sections.name: attrStr
sections.title: Reads text from attributes safely
sections.what: Reads the first non-empty text value found under the given keys in the project's attributes data, trims spaces, and returns null if none exist.
sections.why: Likely reason: location and site type are not regular columns, so they are read from the flexible attributes field.
sections.watch_out: Only the first matching key is used, so the order of keys decides which value wins.

sections.name: SCAN_FIELDS
sections.title: The full list of scan fields
sections.what: Lists every field the scan reads, grouped as cost, schedule, capacity, or top-level, with how each value is read and which evidence labels back it.
sections.why: Likely reason: one list keeps the readers and evidence links in one place.
sections.watch_out: Region always returns null, so the scan never shows a region value taken from the project.

sections.name: scanFieldValueEmpty
sections.title: Checks if a value is missing
sections.what: Says whether a value counts as missing: null, undefined, or empty text.
sections.why: Likely reason: the field builder uses this to decide when a field is empty.
sections.watch_out: Zero counts as a real value, so a stored zero is kept rather than hidden.

sections.name: toLocator
sections.title: Converts stored source keys to a locator
sections.what: Accepts stored source keys and returns a locator only when they contain a type text. Anything else becomes null.
sections.why: Likely reason: matches how the project detail view reads locators, so both views agree.
sections.watch_out: Source keys without a type text are dropped silently, so a quote can appear with no locator.

sections.name: pickEvidence
sections.title: Choosing the best supporting evidence row
sections.what: Picks one piece of supporting evidence for a single data field from a project's evidence list. It ignores inactive rows, prefers rows that have a web link, then the newest dated row, then a fixed id order so the answer does not change between runs. If nothing matches, it returns nothing.
sections.why: Likely reason: the tie-break rules make sure the same data gives the same evidence on every run, as the comment above the function states.
sections.watch_out: The newest-date rule compares dates as plain text, so a date written in a different format could sort in the wrong order.

summary: Holds the single list of fields the Benchmark Scan needs, with how each value is read and which evidence labels back it.
purpose: Defines the field list once, so the scan data builder and the scan readiness check read the same fields in the same way.
why: The file header says this keeps both users identical. Likely reason: it prevents two copies from drifting apart.
how: It defines group names and the shape of a field entry. It includes a helper that reads text from the attributes data. The main list gives each field a key, a group, a reader, and its evidence labels. Small helpers check whether a value is empty and convert stored source keys into a locator. The helper that picks evidence is not included in this packet.
inputs: A project record with its columns and variance data, its attributes data, and evidence rows with their labels.
outputs: A list of field descriptions, plus helper results: an empty check, a locator, and text read from attributes.
risks: Region is always read as null, so no region value ever comes from the project. Budget fields change units by industry, so a wrong industry name shifts every budget. Reason fields fall back from cost to schedule notes.
debug: If a field is always empty, check its reader and its evidence label list. If budgets look off by a factor of one million, check the industry name passed to the budget conversion. If a locator is missing, check that the stored source keys contain a type text.
